title: Game music engine / Mobile friendly song making tool
author: Samfa12
selftext:
Pocket Chordsmith is a family of music tools designed to help developers create and integrate music into games more quickly.

At the centre is Pocket Chordsmith, a browser-based composition tool that stores music as structured musical data rather than recorded audio. Songs can contain chords, bass lines, drum patterns, melodies, guitar rhythms, sections and song arrangements. Because the music remains editable data, it can be exported, remixed, adapted or reused across different projects and engines.

Pocket DJ is a companion performance tool that can import Pocket Chordsmith songs and manipulate their structure in real time. Rather than mixing audio files, it works directly with the musical data, allowing sections, stems and arrangements to be changed on the fly.

The Godot add-on extends this workflow into game development by allowing Pocket Chordsmith projects to be imported and used directly inside Godot. Similar workflows can also be used in HTML, Babylon.js, Three.js and other web-based game projects.

An interesting side effect is that AI systems can work with Pocket Chordsmith project data directly. When an AI has access to a Pocket Chordsmith project, JSON export, HTML build, or the Godot integration, it can analyse the musical structure and generate new songs, arrangements, adaptive music systems, level themes, combat tracks, ambient soundscapes and gameplay-driven variations. This makes the tools particularly useful for rapid prototyping and AI-assisted game development.

Pocket Chordsmith is available at: https://samfa12.itch.io/pocket-chordsmith
